title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
title_zh: 分子自旋链与超导体的偶极性耦合
abstract: Collective behaviour in quantum materials can produce excitations carrying only a fraction of the quantum numbers of their constituents. A notable case occurs in chains of spin-1 units1, in which a topological gap protects the interior of the chain, whereas spin-1/2 states, half the spin of the units that form it, emerge at the ends2. In short chains, these fractional edge spins couple to each other and their topological protection makes them attractive for hybrid spin-superconductor devices. Whether such fractionalization survives the proximity of a superconducting condensate, however, remains an open question. Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconductor by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. Odd-length chains host Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) bound states inside the superconducting gap, originating from a global S = 1 ground state, whereas even-length chains form an S = 0 ground state decoupled from the superconductor. A two-site model attributes this alternation to the sign and strength of inter-edge interactions, independently confirmed by extra-gap spin excitations in tunnelling spectra. Many-body spin excitations of the S = 1 chain are also detected, decoupled from the superconductor by the much larger Haldane gap. The length-tunable coupling of the edge spins to superconductors opens a route towards molecular spin qubits based on π-conjugated carbon architectures.
abstract_zh: 量子材料中的集体行为可以产生只携带其组成部分部分量子数的激发。在自旋1单元链中，一个拓扑缺口保护链的内部，而形成它的自旋1/2状态，即单元自旋的一半，出现在链的两端。在短链中，这些分数自旋边缘相互耦合，它们的拓扑保护使其成为自旋-超导器件的有吸引力的候选对象。然而，这些分数化现象在超导冷凝体附近是否存活，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们在Au(111)/Nb(110)表面上长出偶极耦合的自旋1三角烯自旋1链，并通过扫描隧道谱学解析了它们自旋1/2边缘态与超导体的偶极性耦合。奇长链在超导缺口内托里-希巴-鲁辛诺(YSR)束缚态，源于全局S=1基态，而偶长链形成S=0基态，与超导体解耦。两站点模型将这种交替归因于边缘相互作用的符号和强度，并通过隧道谱学中的额外缺口自旋激发得到独立确认。自旋1链的许多体自旋激发也被检测到，它们由更大的Haldane缺口与超导体解耦。边缘自旋与超导体的长度可调耦合为基于π共轭碳架构的分子自旋量子位提供了途径。
